meta.name: security-scan
meta.description: 对进入系统的文件或 URL 执行安全与合规扫描，输出 pass/reject 判定与扫描报告，作为所有文档处理的强制前置关卡。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描文件与链接，输出安全放行或拒绝的判定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要先审文件或链接是否安全再决定放行
copy.tagline_en: Scan files and links, return pass or reject verdicts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to vet files or links for safety before approving access

howto.what: 装上后,文件或网址进入系统前会先被 Claude 扫描:核对域名黑名单、检查 OA 文档许可、拦截可疑来源,然后输出 pass/reject 判定和风险报告,并留下 trace_id 供追踪。
howto.when: 当系统收到本地文件或外部 URL 时触发,作为所有文档处理流程的第一道闸门;任何文件或网址进入前都要先经过它。

say.text: 请扫描这份 PDF,判定能否接收。
say.note: Claude 会运行安检并给出 pass/reject。

say.text: 帮我查这个网址是否在违规域名黑名单里。
say.note: 若命中黑名单,会拒绝并标记风险。

say.text: 对这个 Excel 做合规扫描,输出判定和风险等级。
say.note: 报告将包含许可状态与命中项。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude first scans incoming files or URLs: checks domain blacklist, OA license, and suspicious-source indicators, then gives pass/reject verdict with a report and trace_id.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the system receives a local file or external URL, acting as the mandatory first gate before any document processing; every incoming file or URL must pass it.

say_en.text: Please scan this PDF and decide if it can be accepted.
say_en.note: Claude will run the security check and return pass/reject.

say_en.text: Check whether this URL is on the forbidden-domain blacklist.
say_en.note: If it matches, the URL is rejected and flagged.

say_en.text: Run a compliance scan on this Excel and output verdict and risk level.
say_en.note: The report includes license status and flagged items.
